Source: https://github.com/JohanAnderssonOstling/HtmlViewCore
Revision: b1e1990b939458a4d612ff7d90be066713ec1444

This is the pinned html-view-core crate with a chapter-start pagination fix.
The correction belongs in RendererCore::prepare_backward: reaching line zero
must restart forward composition at document offset zero, independently of
leading margins, padding, or non-text content. Other HtmlViewCore crates
remain at the same pinned revision.

The regression tests in renderer/nav/tests/chapter_start.rs and the same
source correction are also present in the sibling HtmlViewCore checkout.
Cargo.toml expands upstream workspace dependencies without changing versions.
